# Test fixtures

Fixtures are small, synthetic or clearly licensed text files used to test the static audit pipeline.

Rules:

- No APKs, DEX files, native libraries, or proprietary application code.
- No real secrets, tokens, personal data, or private repository content.
- Prefer synthetic repositories that model suspicious patterns without being usable malware.
- Record the origin and license of any real-world excerpt.
- Keep fixtures small and deterministic.
